.timeline{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:24px;margin:44px 0 26px}.timeline article{border-top:2px solid #9e6b4f;padding:20px 6px 0 0}.timeline .month{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.13em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#a36b4d;font-weight:700}.timeline .month span{display:block;margin-top:5px;letter-spacing:0;text-transform:none;color:#677168;font-weight:400}.timeline h3{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:25px;line-height:1.16;margin:18px 0}.timeline ul{padding-left:18px;line-height:1.6;color:#596259;font-size:14px}.timeline li{margin-bottom:11px}.kula-points + .copy{margin-top:20px}.timeline .t3{font-size:13px;line-height:1.55;color:#596259;margin-top:12px}.timeline .t3 strong{color:#a36b4d}.timeline .outcome{border-top:1px solid #c9c9bd;padding-top:14px;margin-top:22px;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:#30453a}.team-section{background:#ede9de}.team-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:20px;margin:42px 0 28px}.person{border-top:2px solid #315143;padding-top:18px}.photo-placeholder{width:96px;height:96px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;margin:0 0 16px;display:block;background:#d9d4c6}.photo-placeholder{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:28px;color:#827f76}.person h3{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:24px;margin:16px 0 7px}.person p{font-size:13px;line-height:1.65;color:#596259;overflow-wrap:break-word}.person .person-role{font-weight:700;color:#a36b4d;margin-bottom:10px;overflow-wrap:break-word}@media(max-width:850px){.team-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.timeline{grid-template-columns:1fr}.timeline article{padding-bottom:12px}}@media(max-width:490px){.team-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px}.logo{gap:6px}.logo .brand-mark{height:18px}.logo .bcorp-mark{height:16px}.photo-placeholder{width:72px;height:72px}.person h3{font-size:20px}}
h1,h2,h3,.lead,.emphasis{text-wrap:balance}p,li,.copy,.note,.tag,.term{text-wrap:pretty}.closing-line{padding:90px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line);text-align:center}.closing-line .lead{max-width:760px;margin:0 auto;font-size:clamp(26px,3vw,38px);line-height:1.4}.closing-line em{color:var(--accent);font-style:normal}
</style><style>
/* 2026 infrastructure editorial redesign */
:root{--paper:#f5f4ec;--ink:#18342c;--muted:#53695d;--line:#c8d4c9;--accent:#b17b4d;--deep:#102e27;--cream:#f7f6ed}
body{background:var(--paper)}.shell{max-width:1510px}.mast{padding-top:26px;padding-bottom:22px}.logo{font-size:26px}.meta{letter-spacing:.11em}
nav{background:rgba(245,244,236,.95)}nav a{font-weight:600}nav a:hover{color:#97613c}
.hero{position:relative;min-height:780px;grid-template-columns:1.03fr .97fr;gap:2vw;padding-top:65px;padding-bottom:88px}
.hero:before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0 auto auto -6vw;width:43vw;height:100%;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 10% 55%,rgba(151,178,139,.11),transparent 68%)}
h1{font-size:clamp(59px,6.25vw,102px);letter-spacing:-.065em;line-height:1.02}h1 em,h2 em{color:#a46f47}
.hero .lead{max-width:570px;color:#365349;font-size:clamp(23px,2.1vw,30px)}
.hero-art{max-width:none;filter:none;position:relative}.hero-art svg{filter:drop-shadow(0 20px 40px rgba(22,55,38,.12))}
.section{padding:110px 0}.section h2{letter-spacing:-.055em}.eyebrow{color:#9b6b42}.kicker{color:#294d3e}
#context{background:#e9efe6}#context .heard-points{max-width:none;gap:30px 54px}#context .heard-points li{border-top-color:#9db5a3;color:#476355;padding-top:20px}
#context .heard-points strong{color:#173e30}
#contribution{background:#f8f6ef}
#approach{background:#173b30;color:#f6f5ec;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
#approach:after{content:'';position:absolute;right:-70px;top:20px;width:430px;height:430px;border:1px solid rgba(193,221,189,.16);border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 0 65px rgba(193,221,189,.045),0 0 0 130px rgba(193,221,189,.035);pointer-events:none}
#approach .eyebrow{color:#d6b18c}#approach .kicker{color:#f0e9d8}#approach .copy{color:#cfdbcf}
#focused{background:#f4f2e9}#focused .engagement-stack{display:block}#focused .kicker{max-width:700px;margin-bottom:2.4rem}#focused .kula-points{column-gap:3rem}.facts{gap:0;border-top:1px solid #b9c8b9;border-bottom:1px solid #b9c8b9}.fact{border:0;padding:25px 24px 18px}.fact+.fact{border-left:1px solid #b9c8b9}.fact strong{font-size:clamp(30px,3vw,46px);color:#1e503a;letter-spacing:-.045em}.fact p{font-size:13px}
#board{background:#dce8dc}#team{background:#f8f6ef}.person{border-top-color:#4f8262}.person img{border-radius:50%;width:100%;max-width:145px;aspect-ratio:1/1;object-fit:cover;filter:saturate(.72)}
.infra-band{background:#dce8db;padding:40px 0 55px;border-top:1px solid #b6cbb8;border-bottom:1px solid #b6cbb8}
.infra-band .band-head{display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;margin-bottom:20px}
.infra-band .band-head strong{font:normal 28px Georgia,serif;letter-spacing:-.04em}.infra-band .band-head span{font:11px Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#4b7157}
.infra-band svg{width:100%;height:auto;display:block}
.infra-caption{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:26px;margin-top:18px}.infra-caption div{border-top:1px solid #a8c0ad;padding-top:12px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.6;color:#4a6756}.infra-caption b{display:block;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#214b37;margin-bottom:5px}
@media(max-width:850px){.hero{min-height:0;padding-top:52px;gap:12px}.hero-art{max-width:560px}.section{padding:75px 0}.infra-caption{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:10px}.facts{grid-template-columns:1fr}.fact+.fact{border-left:0;border-top:1px solid #b9c8b9}}
@media(max-width:490px){h1{font-size:clamp(46px,12vw,62px)}.hero-art{margin-top:12px}.infra-band{padding:30px 0}.infra-band .band-head strong{font-size:23px}}
#board{background:#e7ede5;border-top:1px solid #b9c9ba}#board .kula-points{color:#41574a}
</style><style>
/* Isometric fractional infrastructure grid hero */
.hero{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,0.9fr) minmax(0,1.1fr);align-items:center;min-height:690px;gap:0;overflow:visible}
.hero>div:first-child{position:relative;z-index:2;padding-right:1.4rem}
.hero-art{position:relative;overflow:visible;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:570px;isolation:isolate}
.hero-art img{width:125%;max-width:none;height:auto;object-fit:contain;display:block;mix-blend-mode:multiply;mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 72% 67% at 54% 49%,#000 56%,transparent 100%);-webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 72% 67% at 54% 49%,#000 56%,transparent 100%)}
@media(max-width:850px){.hero{grid-template-columns:1fr;min-height:0;gap:0}.hero>div:first-child{padding-right:0}.hero-art{min-height:0;margin:0 -4vw}.hero-art img{width:105%}}
</style><style>
/* Construction progression: four asset scenes paired with the existing four-stage text. */
.infra-construction-art{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px;align-items:end;margin:16px 0 10px;overflow:hidden}
.infra-construction-art img{display:block;width:100%;height:180px;object-fit:contain;object-position:center bottom;mix-blend-mode:multiply}
.infra-band .infra-caption{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))}
@media(max-width:700px){.infra-construction-art{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:6px}.infra-construction-art img{height:145px}.infra-band .infra-caption{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}
@media(max-width:440px){.infra-construction-art img{height:112px}}
</style><style>
/* Four equal-size asset tiles; arrows are positioned in the gaps, not on artwork. */
.infra-construction-art{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))!important;gap:clamp(16px,2.8vw,38px)!important;align-items:start!important;overflow:visible!important;margin:22px 0 14px!important}
.infra-construction-art .construction-stage{min-width:0;position:relative;display:block}
.infra-construction-art .construction-image-frame{width:100%;aspect-ratio:1.36;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden}
.infra-construction-art .construction-image-frame img{display:block!important;width:100%!important;height:100%!important;object-fit:contain!important;object-position:center center!important;mix-blend-mode:multiply}
.infra-construction-art .construction-arrow{position:absolute;left:calc(100% + clamp(8px,1.4vw,19px));top:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:clamp(18px,2.1vw,29px);font-weight:400;line-height:1;color:#a65c36;z-index:2;pointer-events:none}
@media(max-width:700px){.infra-construction-art{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))!important;gap:28px 28px!important}.infra-construction-art .construction-stage:nth-child(2) .construction-arrow{display:none}.infra-construction-art .construction-stage:nth-child(3) .construction-arrow{left:calc(100% + 14px)}.infra-construction-art .construction-image-frame{aspect-ratio:1.36}}
@media(max-width:430px){.infra-construction-art{gap:20px 22px!important}.infra-construction-art .construction-arrow{left:calc(100% + 11px)!important;font-size:19px}}
</style><style>
/* v10: Explicit identical tile geometry and image canvases. */
.infra-construction-art{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))!important;column-gap:clamp(22px,3vw,42px)!important;row-gap:24px!important;align-items:stretch!important;overflow:visible!important}
.infra-construction-art .construction-stage{width:100%!important;min-width:0!important}
.infra-construction-art .construction-image-frame{box-sizing:border-box!important;display:block!important;width:100%!important;aspect-ratio:480/310!important;height:auto!important;overflow:hidden!important;border:1px solid rgba(65,87,69,.20)!important;border-radius:3px!important;background:#f5f1e8!important}
.infra-construction-art .construction-image-frame img{width:100%!important;height:100%!important;aspect-ratio:480/310!important;object-fit:fill!important;mix-blend-mode:normal!important}
.infra-construction-art .construction-arrow{left:calc(100% + clamp(11px,1.5vw,21px))!important;top:50%!important;transform:translate(-50%,-50%)!important}
@media(max-width:700px){.infra-construction-art{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))!important;column-gap:34px!important}.infra-construction-art .construction-stage:nth-child(2) .construction-arrow{display:none!important}}
@media(max-width:430px){.infra-construction-art{column-gap:24px!important}.infra-construction-art .construction-arrow{left:calc(100% + 12px)!important}}
</style><style>
/* v11: identical transparent artwork areas, no white image cards */
.infra-construction-art .construction-stage .construction-image-frame {
  width:100%!important; aspect-ratio: 1.13 / 1!important; height:auto!important;
  background:transparent!important; border:0!important; box-shadow:none!important;
  padding:0!important; overflow:visible!important; display:flex!important;
  justify-content:center!important; align-items:center!important;
}
.infra-construction-art .construction-stage .construction-image-frame img {
  display:block!important; width:100%!important; height:100%!important;
  object-fit:contain!important; object-position:center center!important;
  background:transparent!important; border:0!important; box-shadow:none!important;
  transform:none!important; max-width:none!important;
}
.infra-construction-art .construction-stage {min-width:0!important;}
</style><style>
/* Native in-page vector system: equal canvas and exact matching background. */
.infra-band .native-pipeline{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 24px minmax(0,1fr) 24px minmax(0,1fr) 24px minmax(0,1fr);gap:10px;align-items:start;margin:34px 0 12px}
.infra-band .native-step{min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch}
.infra-band .native-art{width:100%;aspect-ratio:320/250;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:transparent;border:0;padding:0}
.infra-band .asset-svg{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:visible}
.infra-band .native-arrow{font:30px/1 Georgia,serif;color:#a85d3d;text-align:center;align-self:start;margin-top:calc((100% + 0px) * 4.5);padding-top:28px}
.infra-band .native-step b{font:600 16px/1.3 Georgia,serif;color:#2f4d3d;display:block;margin:13px 0 7px}
.infra-band .native-step p{font:15px/1.5 Georgia,serif;color:#526359;margin:0}
@media(max-width:800px){.infra-band .native-pipeline{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 18px minmax(0,1fr);row-gap:24px}.infra-band .native-step:nth-child(5){grid-column:1}.infra-band .native-arrow:nth-child(4){display:none}.infra-band .native-arrow{margin-top:55px;padding-top:0}}
@media(max-width:480px){.infra-band .native-pipeline{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:8px}.infra-band .native-arrow{font-size:22px;transform:rotate(90deg);margin:0;line-height:1;padding:0}.infra-band .native-arrow:nth-child(4){display:block}.infra-band .native-step:nth-child(5){grid-column:auto}.infra-band .native-art{max-width:310px;margin:auto}.infra-band .native-step{padding:0 0 10px}.infra-band .native-step b{margin-top:0}}
</style><style>
/* Hybrid illustration system: equal frames, rich generated artwork, HTML-controlled arrows */
.native-pipeline{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr) 25px) minmax(0,1fr)!important;gap:8px!important;align-items:start!important;}
.native-pipeline .native-step{min-width:0!important;}
.native-pipeline .native-art{width:100%!important;height:auto!important;aspect-ratio:1.24!important;display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:center!important;overflow:visible!important;background:transparent!important;border:0!important;box-shadow:none!important;padding:0!important;}
.native-pipeline .native-art img{display:block!important;width:100%!important;height:100%!important;object-fit:contain!important;mix-blend-mode:multiply!important;}
.native-pipeline .native-arrow{display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:center!important;height:auto!important;aspect-ratio:0.16!important;padding-top:0!important;color:#a25b39!important;font-family:Georgia,serif!important;font-size:29px!important;line-height:1!important;}
.native-pipeline .native-step b,.native-pipeline .native-step p{position:relative!important;}
@media(max-width:900px){.native-pipeline{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 22px minmax(0,1fr)!important;row-gap:28px!important;}}
@media(max-width:580px){.native-pipeline{grid-template-columns:1fr!important;gap:10px!important;}.native-pipeline .native-art{max-width:380px;margin:auto;}.native-pipeline .native-arrow{height:22px!important;aspect-ratio:auto!important;transform:rotate(90deg);padding:0!important;margin:auto!important;}}
</style><style>
/* Section 02: editorial four-route presentation */
#contribution .industry-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:0;margin-top:clamp(2rem,4vw,3.5rem);border-top:1px solid rgba(66,82,67,.24);border-left:1px solid rgba(66,82,67,.24)}
#contribution .industry-card{position:relative;padding:clamp(1.4rem,2.6vw,2.5rem);min-width:0;border-right:1px solid rgba(66,82,67,.24);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(66,82,67,.24);background:rgba(248,247,239,.36)}
#contribution .industry-card:nth-child(2),#contribution .industry-card:nth-child(3){background:rgba(218,228,213,.18)}
#contribution .industry-index{display:block;font:500 .73rem/1.4 ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Consolas,monospace;letter-spacing:.12em;color:#a6633c;margin-bottom:1.5rem}
#contribution .industry-card h3{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(1.45rem,2.3vw,2.15rem);line-height:1.18;color:#234c3d;margin:0 0 1.1rem}

</style><style id="kula-commercial-v30">.kula-commercial{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:1px}.kula-commercial .fact{min-width:0}.kula-commercial .success-fee strong{color:var(--accent,#b17b4d)}.kula-commercial .success-fee p{line-height:1.55}.kula-commercial .success-fee b{font-weight:700}.commercial-explainer{margin:28px 0 0;max-width:none;padding:24px 30px;border-left:4px solid var(--accent,#b17b4d);background:rgba(177,123,77,.09);font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:clamp(1.18rem,1.7vw,1.55rem);line-height:1.45;color:#234c3d;font-weight:400}@media(max-width:900px){.kula-commercial{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}@media(max-width:540px){.kula-commercial{grid-template-columns:1fr}}</style><style id="kula-hero-integration-v34">

</style></head><body><header class="mast shell"><div class="logo"><img class="brand-mark" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="RampRate"/><img class="bcorp-mark" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="B Corp Certified"/><span> × </span>Kula</div><div class="meta">Engagement proposal / 29 October 2026</div></header><nav><div class="shell"><a href="#context">What we heard</a><a href="#contribution">What RampRate brings</a><a href="#approach">Why not a referral</a><a href="#focused">The engagement</a><a href="#board">Board role</a><a href="#team">Team</a></div></nav><main><div class="hero shell"><div><p class="eyebrow">A proposal for Kula</p><h1>Market Access &amp; Deal Origination.</h1><p class="lead">A RampRate proposal to build out the sourcing, relationships, and deal flow to bring qualified investment opportunities into the Kula ecosystem.</p></div><div class="hero-art"><img alt="Isometric grid of individual infrastructure parcels with solar farms, data centers, wind energy, water facilities and utility assets, illustrating fractionalized real-world assets" src="data:image/webp;base64,"/></div></div><section class="section" id="context"><div class="shell"><p class="eyebrow">01 / What we heard</p><h2>Kula has built a regulated platform and is raising institutional capital. <span style="color:var(--accent)">What's missing is a consistent flow of qualified deal sourcing.</span></h2><ul class="heard-points"><li><strong>Platform in place.</strong> Licensed VASP, Luxembourg fund for institutions, governance token for retail.</li><li><strong>Capital is building.</strong> ~$400M in discussions; $250M deployment target for 2027 at 8–10% returns. Capital isn’t the constraint. Deal flow is.</li><li><strong>Project financing.</strong> Kula validates projects (financial DD + on-the-ground diligence), takes direct ($5M cap) or hybrid positions pairing its stake with larger tokenized tranches.</li><li><strong>What Kula needs.</strong> Qualified deal sourcing in solar, green data centers, and impact infrastructure. Deal sizes $500K–$5M.</li></ul></div></section><section class="section" id="contribution"><div class="shell"><p class="eyebrow">02 / What RampRate brings</p><h2>Deep industry experience and <em>New routes to market.</em></h2><div class="industry-grid"><article class="industry-card"><span class="industry-index">01</span><h3>Data centers</h3><p>20-plus years sourcing and advising in this space. Direct lines into data centers and into the power, turbines, GPUs, and colocation behind them. Connections with industry networks like Data Center Dynamics and Infrastructure Masons.</p></article><article class="industry-card"><span class="industry-index">02</span><h3>SE Asia data centers</h3><p>Direct line to a 60MW AI data-center campus in northern Thailand with its own solar, gas and battery power and water supply, structured as a 15-year shell-and-core lease; RampRate is a named strategic partner on the project.</p></article><article class="industry-card"><span class="industry-index">03</span><h3>Server &amp; power reuse</h3><p>Relationship with an established hosting operator that repurposes second- and third-life servers retired by hyperscalers, and monetizes spare power capacity in existing facilities that would otherwise go unused.</p></article><article class="industry-card"><span class="industry-index">04</span><h3>Africa solar</h3><p>$0.5M–$2M project network with World Bank/Rockefeller ties, matching Kula’s current deal size and 2027 deployment target.</p></article><article class="industry-card"><span class="industry-index">05</span><h3>LatAm solar</h3><p>advisor relationship with an active tokenization protocol in LatAm (~$200M+ pipeline, retail base built, no institutional partner yet).</p></article><article class="industry-card"><span class="industry-index">06</span><h3>SE Asia mini-grid solar</h3><p>16-site mini-grid solar portfolio across SE Asia raising ~$20M, with government approvals already secured and due diligence already completed.</p></article><article class="industry-card"><span class="industry-index">07</span><h3>Broader impact infrastructure</h3><p>$240M impact-project pipeline built by Rob &amp; Ben at Silta Finance, relationships still live, beyond solar and data centers.</p></article></div></div></section><section class="section" id="approach"><div class="shell"><p class="eyebrow">03 / Why this isn’t a simple referral engagement</p><h2>Infrastructure owners aren’t shopping for tokenization.</h2><div class="split"><p class="kicker">Most infrastructure owners or developers have never heard of tokenization. A referral works when the buyer already knows what they want and just needs an introduction. Here, the buyer doesn’t know what they want yet.</p><div class="copy"><p>That gap is what takes this beyond a referral: explaining the concept in terms specific to their asset, putting a credible advocate in the room so it doesn’t land as a crypto pitch, and advising them as they build the business case around their actual structure before a deal can even be scoped.</p><p>Without this work, an introduction would be premature: there’s no deal yet for Kula to look at, just an infrastructure owner who’s not ready to convert yet. This engagement is what gets them there.</p></div></div></div></section><section class="section" id="focused"><div class="shell"><p class="eyebrow">04 / The engagement</p><h2>A 6 month retainer engagement. <em>Building a qualified real-world infrastructure pipeline.</em></h2><div class="split engagement-stack"><p class="kicker">RampRate acts as Kula’s partnerships team: sourcing, qualifying and introducing projects and building relationships with the institutions behind large portfolios of infrastructure projects.</p><ul class="kula-points"><li><strong>Scope.</strong> Impact infrastructure broadly, with green data centers and LatAm and Africa solar already flagged by Paul as priority channels.</li><li><strong>Generate, qualify, position and handover projects.</strong> Source, screen and connect infrastructure projects to Kula’s model.</li><li><strong>Education, not just connection.</strong> Each project needs the concept explained in the owner’s own terms, trust built with a credible advocate in the room, and a case tailored to its specifics.</li><li><strong>Structuring input.</strong> Help shape how a project is positioned financially (direct stake, tokenized tranche, or hybrid), not just explain the concept.</li><li><strong>Build partnerships.</strong> Develop institutional relationships (e.g. Development Finance Institutions, Project Preparation Facilities (PPFs), etc.) for access to large project pipelines and co-financing opportunities.</li><li><strong>Capital-side introductions, where relevant.</strong> Tony may also open conversations with capital partners in his network where there’s genuine interest, not a pipeline commitment or guarantee of capital, but a channel kept open alongside the project work.</li><li><strong>Support through to close.</strong> Stay engaged with Kula through diligence and negotiation, helping drive sourced projects and partnerships toward close rather than stopping at introduction.</li><li><strong>Reporting and tracking.</strong> A simple running pipeline tracker and regular check-ins with Kula’s team, so status, progress and next steps stay visible on both sides.</li><li><strong>Industry representation.</strong> Optional representation and attendance at industry and institutional events, if desired.</li><li><strong>Board role.</strong> Tony’s board role (below) is separate from this engagement’s fee.</li></ul></div><div class="facts kula-commercial"><div class="fact"><strong>$15,000/mo</strong><p>Months 1–2 (discounted rate)</p></div><div class="fact"><strong>$25,000/mo</strong><p>Months 3–6</p></div><div class="fact"><strong>2 months</strong><p>Review point, option to terminate</p></div><div class="fact success-fee"><strong>10%</strong><p><b>Success fees</b> · Typically 10% of net revenue generated from deals introduced by RampRate, subject to confirmation against Kula’s fee structure and transaction economics.</p></div></div><p class="commercial-explainer">The retainer covers the cost of the RampRate team doing the work. Success fees provide the upside when introduced deals generate net revenue.</p></div></section><section class="section" id="board"><div class="shell"><p class="eyebrow">05 / Tony and the Kula board</p><h2>A seat at the table.</h2><div class="split"><p class="kicker">Kula has an open Non-Executive Director seat at Kula Group Limited. Tony would fill this seat.</p><ul class="kula-points"><li><strong>Background.</strong> Founder and CEO of RampRate, with 25+ years advising enterprise clients including Microsoft, Sony and Intel, and decades of senior relationships across technology and infrastructure. The board seat draws on that network and strategic judgment, separate from the day-to-day sourcing and deal work the RampRate team delivers under this engagement.</li><li><strong>The role.</strong> A Non-Executive Director seat at Kula Group Limited, subject to Kula’s usual vetting and a fiduciary duty. Tony contributes board-level governance, introductions into his network of institutional and family-office capital relationships, and direction on extending Kula’s model into new infrastructure verticals such as data centers and community-ownership structures. Terms to be negotiated separately.</li><li><strong>Kept separate.</strong> Parallel to the main engagement, with terms and compensation separate. Tony would declare RampRate’s engagement as an interest and step out of related board decisions, per Kula’s conflict policy.</li></ul></div></div></section><section class="section team-section" id="team"><div class="shell"><p class="eyebrow">06 / Who would do the work</p><h2>A small accountable team. <em>Specialists as needed.</em></h2><p class="kicker">A core group with complementary data-center, infrastructure and partnership experience.</p><div class="team-grid"><article class="person"><img alt="Tony Greenberg" loading="lazy" src="data:image/jpeg;base64,"/><h3>Tony Greenberg</h3><p class="person-role">Proposed Non-Executive Director &amp; senior relationships</p><p>Founder and CEO of RampRate, with 25+ years advising enterprise clients including Microsoft, Sony and Intel. Tony has spent decades building senior relationships across technology and infrastructure. For Kula, he will bring relationships within the data-center sector and provide strategic vision on new applications of tokenization, including opportunities to connect infrastructure development with community ownership and participation.</p></article><article class="person"><img alt="Alex Veytsel" loading="lazy" src="data:image/jpeg;base64,"/><h3>Alex Veytsel</h3><p class="person-role">Data-center sourcing &amp; relationships</p><p>RampRate co-founder and Chief Strategy Officer, with two decades advising major technology companies on commercial strategy, sourcing and infrastructure economics. Alex brings direct experience to sourcing data-center opportunities alongside Tony, and will support deal structuring and tokenization mechanics on sourced projects, drawing on his own experience building SPV and capital-structure models and running tokenization deals.</p></article><article class="person"><img alt="Rob Holmes" loading="lazy" src="data:image/jpeg;base64,"/><h3>Rob Holmes</h3><p class="person-role">Partnerships &amp; coordination</p><p>Web3 and business development strategist with seven-plus years connecting blockchain ventures with real-world infrastructure, clean energy and tokenized assets. Rob also worked with Ben leading the partnerships team that secured a $240M impact-project pipeline at Silta Finance. Prior to this he spent ten years working in the civil engineering sector, securing multi-million infrastructure transactions with government and financial institutions. He will coordinate the engagement, develop relationships with project owners, developers and institutions, and support projects through to close.</p></article><article class="person"><img alt="Ben Sheppard" loading="lazy" src="data:image/jpeg;base64,"/><h3>Ben Sheppard</h3><p class="person-role">Energy &amp; infrastructure opportunities</p><p>Four-time founder with one exit and 22 years in business, including a decade working on infrastructure finance, M&A and large institutional transactions. Ben has advised on more than $1B in public- and private-sector deals, including a $67M acquisition, and has negotiated with development banks and multilaterals. He brings that experience to sourcing, qualifying and advancing infrastructure partnerships.</p></article></div><p class="note">Staffed around sourcing, qualifying, partnerships and industry events, with specialists available as needed.</p></div></section><div class="closing-line shell"><p class="lead">Kula has built the platform. <em>RampRate will help grow its asset tokenization pipeline.</em></p></div></main><footer class="footer shell"><span>RampRate × Kula</span><span>Confidential discussion draft · 29 October 2026</span></footer></body></html>
